entities.name: Ömer Faruk Efendi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Şehzade Ömer Faruk Efendi was an Ottoman prince, the son of the last Ottoman caliph Abdulmejid II and his first consort Şehsuvar Hanım. He was also the son-in-law of Sultan Mehmed VI of the Ottoman Empire because he married his younger daughter Rukiye Sabiha Sultan.
